name: Resmetirom

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hepatotoxicity : Monitor patients during treatment with REZDIFFRA for elevations in liver tests and for the development of liver-related adverse reactions. Discontinue REZDIFFRA and continue to monitor the patient if hepatotoxicity is suspected. (5.1) Gallbladder-Related Adverse Reactions :…

summary: Official drug warnings note that people taking Resmetirom should be monitored for gallbladder issues and hepatotoxicity, which is liver damage shown by higher test levels or liver-related problems. [3] If liver damage is suspected, the medication should be stopped while the person continues to be monitored. [3] Additionally, a small computer model rather than testing on people estimated a high liver score of 72 and a low heart score of 30. [M]
